description_en: Queries the details of a call
description_zh: 查询呼叫通话详情信息
name: QueryConversationDetailInfo

parameters.help_en: The task ID. You can view the task ID on the Call task management page or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2926799.html operation to obtain the task ID
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID。在呼叫任务管理界面查看任务ID或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2926799.html接口获取任务ID
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The task detail ID. You can view the task detail ID in the upper-left corner of the Call task management > Details > Execution records > Completed > Call details page or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2926853.html operation to obtain the task detail ID
parameters.help_zh: 任务明细ID。在呼叫任务管理>详情>执行记录>已完成>通话详情界面左上角查看任务明细ID或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2926853.html接口获取任务明细ID
parameters.name: detail_id

parameters.help_en: The task batch ID. This is the batch ID returned when you import called numbers. You can view the task batch ID on the Call task management > Details > Execution records page or obtain the batch ID returned when you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2926815.html operation to import called numbers
parameters.help_zh: 任务批次ID。即为导入被叫数据时返回的批次ID，在呼叫任务管理>详情>执行记录界面查看任务批次ID或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2926815.html接口导入被叫数据时返回的导入批次ID
parameters.name: batch_id

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details of the access denial

CallId.description_en: The unique ID of the call

CallResult.description_en:
The call result. Valid values:
CALL_FORWARDING: call forwarding
INCOMING_CALL_BARRED: incoming calls barred
CALL_REJECTED: call rejected
ANSWERED: answered
USER_BUSY: user busy
POWERED_OFF: powered off
NO_USER_RESPONSE: no user response
OPERATOR_BLOCK: blocked by the carrier
OTHERS: other statuses
SUSPEND: suspended
CANCEL: canceled by the caller
INVALID_NUMBER: invalid number
UNAVAILABLE: temporarily unavailable
NETWORK_BUSY: network busy
NO_ANSWER: no answer
CallResult.description_zh:
呼叫结果。取值：
CALL_FORWARDING：呼叫转移。
INCOMING_CALL_BARRED：限制呼入。
CALL_REJECTED：拒接。
ANSWERED：用户接通。
USER_BUSY：被叫忙。
POWERED_OFF：关机。
NO_USER_RESPONSE：不在服务区。
OPERATOR_BLOCK：运营商拦截。
OTHERS：其他状态。
SUSPEND：停机。
CANCEL：主叫取消。
INVALID_NUMBER：空号。
UNAVAILABLE：暂时无法接通。
NETWORK_BUSY：网络忙。
NO_ANSWER：无应答

Duration.description_en: The duration of the call. The value is 0 if the call is not connected. Unit: seconds
Duration.description_zh: 通话时长，未打通情况下为0，单位：秒

EncryptionType.description_en:
The encryption method. Valid values:
0: no encryption
1: MD5
2: SHA256
3: SM3

HangupDirection.description_en:
The party that hung up. Valid values:

0: user
1: chatbot
HangupDirection.description_zh:
挂断方向。取值：

0：用户。
1：机器人

OutId.description_en: The external business transaction ID. You can use a unique ID to associate business data
OutId.description_zh: 外部传入的业务流水号，可用唯一ID做业务关联

OutputTagDescription.example: 评估客户对车型的兴趣和购买可能性

PickUpTime.description_en: The time when the call was answered. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds
PickUpTime.description_zh: 电话接听时间。时间戳格式，单位：毫秒

RecordingFileDownloadUrl.description_en: The download URL of the recording file. This field is returned only after the recording file is generated
RecordingFileDownloadUrl.description_zh: 录音文件下载地址，只有生成录音文件后才有该字段

ReleaseTime.description_en: The time when the call ended. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds
ReleaseTime.description_zh: 通话结束时间，时间戳，单位毫秒

StartCallTime.description_en: The time when the call started. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds
StartCallTime.description_zh: 开始呼叫时间，时间戳，单位：毫秒

StatusCode.description_en: The call status code. For more information, see [Call status codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112804.html） of Voice Messaging
StatusCode.description_zh: 呼叫状态码。在语音服务[呼叫状态码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112804.html）中查看

StatusMsg.description_en: The call status message returned by the carrier
StatusMsg.description_zh: 运营商返回的呼叫状态信息

Variables.description_en: The list of call variables. These are the call variables associated with the call task that you created
Variables.description_zh: 通话变量列表。即为您创建的呼叫任务所关联的通话变量

Required.description_en:
Specifies whether the variable is required. Valid values:

true: yes

false: no
Required.description_zh:
是否必填。取值：

true：是。

false：否

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:
true: yes
false: no
Success.description_zh:
调用接口是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败
